title: IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information…
description: IBM Engineering AI Hub versions 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.6, indicating significant confidentiality impact but limited integrity and no availability impact. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
